finalText:
**4.2.0 entry written to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

One real feature: webhook deliveries now retry with backoff. No breaking changes this cycle.

The rest is 11 fixes worth telling users about, the standouts being `401` now returned for expired tokens (was `403`) and full request bodies no longer landing in logs. Everything else was dependency bumps, refactors, and test churn — left out.
